name: Wheat

sources.fao56: Allen et al. 1998, FAO-56 Tables 11, 12, 22: T11 wheat 'Dec, Calif. Desert' 160 d (closest arid row to Pakistan Nov-Apr season); T12 spring wheat, cereals Kc ini 0.30; T22 spring wheat 1.0-1.5 m; FAO-33 spring wheat (Pakistan wheat is spring type)
sources.ky: FAO-33 seasonal Ky, as reprinted in FAO-66 ch.2 Table 1
sources.temp_c: FAO EcoCrop (Triticum aestivum): TMIN/TOPMN/TOPMX/TMAX; copy from github.com/OpenCLIM/ecocrop EcoCrop_DB.csv
sources.heat_day_c: ASSUMPTION - reported only, not used in the index

notes: Checked 2026-11-14 against FAO-56 HTML tables, FAO-66 Table 1 and the EcoCrop database. Rules: Zr = midpoint of the Table 22 range; Kc end = dry-harvest value; Kc ini = Table 12 group value. EcoCrop KTMP kept for reference only (ecocrop_ktmp): it is defined for monthly mean minimum minus 5 °C, so applying it to daily lows would wrongly kill hardy winter crops.
